description: PROP-AUTH-012 first test case at auth-flow.test.ts:137-159 uses legacy 3-argument handleAuthRequest('/v1/auth/discord/callback', {}, frontendBaseUrl) which routes to handleLegacyAuthRequest. The legacy callback handler (shell/index.ts:222-225) unconditionally returns 302 with no state verification, making the test tautological: the 'if (response.statusCode === 302)' branch always triggers regardless of input validity. This is a persistence of iter2 FIND-103. The second test at lines 161-189 properly uses the structured form and is meaningful.
